english.title: Aid abet fishing / take fish without a licence with a rod and line
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) aided, abetted, counselled or procured, another, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), to fish or take fish otherwise than in accordance with a licence by means of a rod and line
english.legislation: Contrary to section 27(1)(a) of and Schedule 4 to the Salmon and Freshwater Fisheries Act 1975 and section 44 of the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980.
